validated_with.note: Only listed IDs were observed by this pack's process (Issue #89). Tiers of the other families follow the official model docs (read 2026-11-01); Fable 5.1 was not evaluated by this pack.

responsibility: A copy that a user edits is the user's own choice and responsibility; the agent never edits this file to get past a stop.

haiku.basis: Official: lowest latency and price, for example subagent tasks (models overview, choosing-a-model, read 2026-11-01).

sonnet.basis: Official: speed and capability for everyday coding and agent work (choosing-a-model, read 2026-11-01).

opus.basis: Official: complex agentic coding; most workloads start with Opus 5.5 (choosing-a-model, read 2026-11-01). This project: observed in transcripts (Issue #89).

fable.basis: Official: highest capability, demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work; slower and priced above Opus 5.5; use it when Opus 5.5 at higher effort still falls short (models overview, choosing-a-model, read 2026-11-01). Not evaluated by this pack (Issue #96 supersedes FU-020).
